children.key: Hidden within the dust cloud is a ship. It is powered down but does not appear damaged. There is no response to your hails.

The crew is dead. There are no signs of a struggle. The corpses have completely rotted away, but they wore human clothing. The captain's clothes are particularly similar to your own. A datapad is at the captain's side.
Power cells long dormant fire up, bringing the data pad back to life. The text is in your language! Much of the data is corrupted, but you find the captain's final log entry:

"Our mission hit an unexpected complication. The trajectory of the Quantum Drive was disrupted by the manifestation of a temporal aftershock in the chronology. The Time Skipper arrived in one piece. But the drive was damaged and we arrived 888 years too early. Fortunately, I know where we are. I doubt we'll encounter anyone from our galaxy in this place, so we are unlikely to disrupt the chronology of this quantum ley line. And the presence of the Star Gazers means they can lead you here when you need to be. Our target is probably going to arrive at World's End soon after you read this. Do not allow the target to reach our galaxy. The future depends on it. We'll do our best to preserve this ship and its technology to aid you in completing the mission. I'm certain you will succeed." - Captain <first> <last>"

children.key: You see Taely at the cafeteria, but she's not eating. When she notices you, she waves you over. She signs, "Captain <last>, you are just the person I wanted to see!"
"Is there something you need from me?"
She looks at you in confusion. Before a misunderstanding can escalate, you explain that it was a joke.
She responds, "Sometimes the humor of ancient Earth is lost on me."
"Is there something you need from me?"

"While passing through <waypoints> a science team noted what looked like new warships being tested by the Korath." She shows you a picture. "Unfortunately they could not get more data without revealing their presence."

She signs, "I would like to suggest something more bold. Can you steal one and bring it back here? I want to get a close look at it. You can keep it once we are done studying it." A prototype Korath warship would be a nice catch. On the other hand, you have no idea how dangerous it is.

description: Transport Ciconia to <destination> and search for the abandoned Avialae ship, Ancient Memory.

values: Transport Ciconia to <destination> and search for the abandoned Avialae ship, Ancient Memory.

children.key: A Remnant approaches you and signs, "Captain <last>, may I request your assistance?" Her face seems familiar. As you try to remember where you've seen her before she adds, "Thanks to your efforts, I was one of the fortunate ones to survive the destruction of our outpost on Baianus."

"My name is Ciconia. Before you were asked to intervene, I was supposed to retrieve the equipment from Baianus. But my ship, the Ancient Memory, was forced into a crash landing by the Korath. I would like to return to Baianus and salvage the ship, if possible."
"The Ancient Memory was probably obliterated during the attack."
"Can't you just get a new ship from the shipyard?"
"While I cannot deny that possibility, I still hold out hope that the wreckage is salvageable."
"The Ancient Memory was not just any ship. It was one of the last surviving Avialae, from the first generation in modern Remnant ship design! The Prefects halted production on them centuries ago."

She pauses to gather her thoughts then continues, "Unfortunately, my request to lead a salvage operation was denied by the Prefects. So now you are my last hope. Would you fly me to Baianus to search for the remains of the Ancient Memory?"
"Sorry, you will have to find some other way there."
"Thank you Captain <last>! May the Embers light our way."
"I am sorry for wasting your time." She walks away, dejected.

values: A Remnant captain who lost her ship during the battle at Bainus.

children.key: Some Korath are surveilling the area. You had better eliminate them before they call for backup.

description: Bring Ciconia to Viminal to gather supplies for salvaging the Ancient Memory.

children.key: A quick scan of the planet's surface reveals the location of the Ancient Memory. Half covered in glistening snow, the hull of the Avialae is surprisingly intact. The engines, however, are thoroughly destroyed. What's worse, it appears the Korath have already picked it clean of its other outfits. But Ciconia seems hopeful. "It will be a massive undertaking, but the Ancient Memory can be saved. Let's go to Viminal."

children.key: Ciconia has arranged for the necessary equipment and personnel to salvage the Ancient Memory. Transport them to Baianus.

Soon after your arrival, a Magpie decloaks and sends a hail. An unfamiliar Remnant addresses you: "Greetings Captain <last>. What brings you to Parca?" He ends his gestues with an elaborate flourish. Something about his demeanor reminds you of a Paradise Worlder speaking to people from the Dirt Belt with contempt. Ciconia, for her part, averts her eyes from the view screen.
"We are here for the Ancient Memory."
"But have you not already been to Parca? What reason would you have to return?"
"We are conducting salvage operations. I trust you will not interfere."
"That rusted hulk is nothing more than scrap, barely fit to be melted down for its raw material value!"
Before you respond, Korath raiding vessels enter the system. The mysterious Magpie cloaks, leaving you to face the attack alone.

children.key: Ciconia and her crew work tirelessly to repair the Ancient Memory.
"Who was that Remnant on the Magpie?"
"What will you do once the Ancient Memory is repaired?"

Ciconia clenches her fist in frustration. "A Remnant Prefect who is a strong opponent of allowing large utility ships into the Remnant fleets. He, and others like him, are heavily in favor of dismantling them for spare parts whenever they are found. Your discovery of the Shattered Light only emboldened them to be more active."

Ciconia thinks a moment then signs, "If we rejoin the Remnant fleets once we are done here, I suspect we will not be allowed to keep the Ancient Memory. I hope you will not mind if we join you instead. The Avialae is an old ship, but I am sure it could prove to be a beneficial part of your fleet."
